title: From pilot to paradigm: a call for entrepreneurial strategies to scale up the implementation of nature-based solutions
authors_or_organisation: Tara Op de Beeck and Tom Coppens
publisher_or_platform: Tara Op de Beeck and Tom Coppens
evidence_limitations: Only the abstract was available to the captured discovery process.

ai_annotation.summary: The article asks how cities can move nature-based solutions beyond isolated pilots and discusses more proactive implementation strategies and their potential co-benefits.
ai_annotation.reason_for_relevance: Moving from pilots to city-wide delivery is central to the lab's interest in implementation arrangements and learning.
